review.summary: I reviewed only the supplied revision (sha256:4d009327…): the helper, its tests, the resolver excerpt and the stated integration facts. I didn't see the UI source. This isn't approval of the whole WP08 work package, and it doesn't certify test or release results. The two earlier findings are closed. (1) Whitespace: referenceOptions now trims names and labels whitespace-only names as unnamed. The test covers '報名頁' vs ' 報名頁 ' and '   ', and checks that the source data isn't changed. (2) Payment dictionary drift: paymentStatusLabels uses `satisfies Record<PaymentWebhookEventType | "pending" | "cancelled" | "expired", string>`. Adding an event type now breaks typecheck, and stray extra keys are rejected. A test passes every resolvePaymentStatus result for null/pending through the payment labels. Unknown values and inherited names such as `__proto__`, `constructor` and `toString` show '未知狀態' in every domain. Option values are passed through unchanged. I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR issues. There are two minor items: a gap in how duplicate names are told apart, and a snapshot gap in the tests.

findings.issue: The fix for duplicate names only adds a suffix to names that are exactly equal. A merchant's name can already look like a suffixed name, so two options can still show the same text.
findings.evidence: ids ['a','b','c'], names {a:'報名頁（第 2 項）', b:'報名頁', c:'報名頁'}: counts makes 'a' unique and leaves it as is, while 'b' becomes '報名頁（第 2 項）'. That gives two options with the same visible text. Similarly, trim() doesn't remove zero-width characters (e.g. '報名頁​'), so names that look identical aren't counted as duplicates.
findings.impact: The stored value is still correct because option.value is unchanged. But a merchant can see two identical options in the step or popup picker and pick the wrong target. This is unlikely, and it only happens with names the merchant entered.
findings.recommended_fix: Check uniqueness on the final labels after adding suffixes. If any collide, give every colliding entry a position suffix, or keep adding suffixes until all labels are unique. You could also strip zero-width and format characters (e.g. /[​-‍﻿]/g) along with trim().
findings.required_test: Add a referenceOptions case where one name equals another option's suffixed label, plus a zero-width-space case. Assert that new Set(labels).size === ids.length and that the values are unchanged.

findings.area: 'keeps the approved display dictionary reviewable' snapshot
findings.issue: The terminology snapshot leaves out the order, verification and payment status dictionaries. Most order-status labels (draft, pending_payment, payment_failed, cancelled, partially_refunded, refunded) and UNVERIFIED have no test checking their text.
findings.evidence: orderStatusLabels, verificationStatusLabels and paymentStatusLabels aren't exported or included in toMatchSnapshot. For orders, the only check is reportStatusLabel('expired','order') equalling the payment label.
findings.impact: `satisfies` makes sure every key exists, but a wrong or changed Chinese label in the status dictionaries would pass the terminology snapshot unnoticed.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the reportStatusLabel output for each known status in each domain to the snapshot, or export the status dictionaries for snapshotting only.
findings.required_test: Add a snapshot of reportStatusLabel output for every CommerceOrderStatus, FormSubmissionVerificationStatus, and payment key.
